# Sequence Feature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SequenceFeature>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A feature or annotation on a biological sequence — a range with start, end, strand, and type, expressed in a reference assembly frame. The first-class entity that carries the coordinates and type; linked to a [`BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md).

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a feature/annotation on a biological sequence — a gene, exon, SNP, or CDS with start, end, strand, and type in an assembly frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the container chromosome ([`gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md)) and avoid coordinates without an assembly frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Mint [`SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md), set [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](../properties/gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md), attach [`gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceCoordinates.md), and link from the container via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md).

### Examples

- ex:brca1 a [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md); [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](../properties/gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md) [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureTypeGene`](../individuals/gmeow-sequenceFeatureTypeGene.md); [`gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceCoordinates.md) ex:brca1Coords.
